notes.pro_rata_share: Single-tenant building. Section 2.2 explicitly states 100% for building-exclusive elements.
notes.admin_fee_percent: Section 5.5 allows 'reasonable allowance for Landlord's overhead' but specifies no percentage. The 20% in Section 3.1 is penalty-specific for remedial repairs only.
notes.excluded_pools: Capital expenditures excluded from CAM (Section 5.5) except: (a) maintenance items, (b) cost-reducing items, (c) Capital Repairs per Section 3.1, (d) items required by law -- all amortized over useful life per GAAP.
notes.accounting_basis: Inferred from GAAP amortization reference in Section 5.5
